topic: How a technician restores a desk lamp

scenes.title: THE LAMP GOES DARK
scenes.subtitle: Find the power source.
scenes.narration: The desk lamp suddenly goes dark. A technician walks over to check its power source before starting repairs.

scenes.title: LIFT THE BATTERY
scenes.subtitle: A careful, controlled pickup.
scenes.narration: She reaches across the worktable for the battery and carefully lifts it while keeping the equipment steady.

scenes.title: LOOK FOR DAMAGE
scenes.subtitle: A closer inspection.
scenes.narration: Holding it close, she checks both electrical contacts for scratches, loose connections, or signs of corrosion.

scenes.title: SET IT DOWN
scenes.subtitle: Controlled placement on the table.
scenes.narration: Next she slowly lowers the battery onto the worktable beside the lamp, preparing for a controlled test.

scenes.title: LIGHT RETURNS
scenes.subtitle: Verify that electricity is flowing.
scenes.narration: Finally, she reconnects and tests the lamp. A bright glow confirms electricity is flowing through the circuit again.
